items.title: Willie "Old Man" Parker Interview, 1958-11-07
items.q: I heard of him in a long time. Bad Frank. Oh, yeah. He was a big old player.

ctx.x: Seven pieces, huh? Mm-hmm. They had a chord in bass guitar.

He had chord in bass guitar, trombone, and drums, and clarinet of music. I should've followed by a chord in bass guitar. I should've followed by a chord in bass guitar. I heard of him in a long time. Bad Frank. Oh, yeah. He was a big old player. Mm-hmm. That old Bad Frank. Old brick-ed fella. He could play that big old tune. He could play that big old tune.
Well, what color hair did he have? Huh? What color hair did he have? Bad Frank.
